The main takeaway from our work is that
the ASE threshold is not simply inversely proportional to the film thickness, as previously reported.
the ASE threshold can be reduced by increasing the film thickness and by using high-refractive-index substrates.
, in order to achieve high-efficiency ASE in thin organic films, it is necessary to use high-absorbing materials, to properly design the waveguiding layer, and to optimize the film thickness.
